QuestInfo.parent: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: A Worn-Out Bow
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p221# of #m10001000# has yet another favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: Inside #p221#'s box was a small, old bow. But it had fallen apart after all that time, and #p221# said #b#p208##k should be able to fix it. It seems I should head to #b#p208##k at #b#m10001040##k and show them the bow. Still, if this bow is centuries old, just how many long years has #p221# been alive for?  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I showed #t4031124# to #p208#. I hope he's able to fix it...

0.0: That's right. What was inside the box was this small, worn-out bow. I imagine you might have been expecting something more, judging by that disappointed look on your face.
0.1: This bow... hundreds of years have passed since then, and yet it still looks just as it did. But even so, the years have taken their toll. The bowstring seems to have worn through, so it doesn't look like it can be used as it is. Hmm... That's right! #b#p208##k might be able to fix it. Would you mind taking it to him and asking him to have a look?

yes.0: Thank you. I'd love to ask him myself, but I can't very well have aspiring archers making the trip here for nothing. You should be able to find #b#p208##k at #b#m10001040##k. I'll wait here for you, then.

no.0: I see. It seems repairing this bow might have to wait a little longer.

1.0: #h0#, I actually already heard you'd become a #bCitizen of Honor#k of our #m10001000#. Now that's something to celebrate! So, what brings you here today?
1.1: #p221# asked you to have me take a look and see if I can fix this #t4031124#, is that right? Would you mind showing it to me? Hmm... this is...

item.0: #p221# asked you to have me take a look and see if I can fix this #t4031124#, is that right? But where is it, exactly?

lost.0: I had a feeling you'd be back. You lost the #t4031124# I gave you, didn't you? Fortunately, a passing adventurer picked it up and brought it back to me. Please, do take good care of this bow.
